newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Yoshiya proposes 1-for-2 rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Yoshiya proposes 1-for-2 rights issue.

text.p: Yoshiya International Corp Ltd said on Tuesday it proposes to raise about HK$57 million before expenses through a one-for-two rights issue of 96.55 million new shares at HK$0.59 per rights share.
The subscription price represents a discount of about 29 percent to the Monday closing price of HK$0.83, the property group said in a statement.
Warrants entitling holders to subscribe for new shares at HK$0.50 per share will be granted to rights shares holders on a three-for-five basis, it added.
The company said the warrants would be exercisable at any time from the date of granting until December 31, 1998.

Under the terms of the warrants, any holders who elect to exercise the subscription rights on or before June 27, 1997, will be entitled to receive an additional warrant for each new share issued, it said.
Yoshiya said it will use about HK$10 million of the proceeds for general working capital and the rest to reduce the group's bank borrowings.
